term: world-relative existence, metaphysical esse, necessity and explanation
resolution: The indexed senses distinguish world-relative candidate existence (DEF-KANT-ONTOLOGICAL-MODEL), external support by distinct actual individuals (DEF-EXISTENTIAL-SUPPORT-MODEL), and the new actual present-source relation without a built-in distinctness restriction (DEF-PRESENT-ESSE-SUPPORT). Boundary's ExistsAt does not analyze the act of being (DEF-ESSE) or explain why an existence fact obtains. Neither supportsEsse relation is automatically Aquinas' efficient cause/conservation of esse (DEF-EXTERNAL-CAUSE-OF-ESSE), an adequate PSR explanation, or a necessary condition of the target's existence. NecessaryAt does not entail an intrinsic reason, identity of essence and esse (DEF-ESSENCE-THOMISTIC-NATURE), or necessary-per-se status (DEF-NECESSARY-PER-SE). These wider source meanings remain separate. UNDERIVED-ROUTE-EXIT, NECESSARILY-UNDERIVED-FROM-ACTUAL-GROUNDED and UNDERIVED-ROUTE-CONTROLS instantiate the supportsEsse parameter at a Profile's selected relation grounds (DEF-UNDERIVED-ROOT-ROUTE). This is a choice of parameter, with no identification of grounds with efficient causation, Aquinas' cause of esse or explanation. In the owner-adopted cogito specialization (#1113), DEF-COGITO-ESSE-PROFILE fixes concrete to HasEsseInRe and explicitly requires ExistingInActAt at the selected world. Real existence then entails concreteness, so the concrete restriction adds nothing further for existing grounds. This is a specialization with a declared contract, not a theorem equating the unrelated predicates of every legacy Profile. Not forked (batch 4 of #1233): its senses are different framework interfaces with different Lean types (the Ontic structure, ExternallySupportedAt, PresentEsseSupport, UnderivedRootAt), not rival readings of one use. Only DEF-KANT-ONTOLOGICAL-MODEL reaches the root; the root-path statements that link this record (STMT-ACT-OF-ESSE-SUFFICES-FOR-EXISTENCE-AT, STMT-EXISTING-IN-ACT-AT, STMT-ESSE-CAUSE-IS-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUND) pass between world-relative existence and esse only through those explicit bridge premises. The term that does carry two senses on the root route is 'existence' (ExistsAt at the selected world versus InAct · esse), a candidate fork whose bridges already exist (needs: a disambiguation listing DEF-KANT-ONTOLOGICAL-MODEL and DEF-ESSE as senses of one use).
